title: ARCADE: PARTY SCOREBOARD AND INITIALS
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 18 of 20. The party night needs a board to beat. The arcade now keeps its own scoreboard under its own storage key, never his save: one row per run, written at every extraction and again at the run end, so a crash or a reload keeps the score. TONIGHTS BEST on the attract shows the top 10 of the last 12 hours with initials, plus BEST EVER. A run that makes tonights top 10 gets a 3 letter initials card on the RUN OVER card, on both windows: on the pad up and down change the letter, right or A goes on, left or B goes back and MENU finishes, and player 2 works it from its own pad; on the keyboard type the letters, Backspace and Enter. 20 seconds with no input keeps what is there, or ??? if nobody touched it, and while the card is up nobody drops in by accident. NEW HIGH SCORE is called once per run on both windows when the team passes tonights best. Normal raids write and draw nothing new.
now: In the arcade a top 10 run now enters 3 initials for TONIGHTS BEST, and passing the best of the night calls NEW HIGH SCORE.
